name: Relight
summary: Relights a photo with a preset light or your own direction, softness, brightness and color, keeping the scene intact.

source.notes: Native Qwen Image Edit 2511 INT8 ConvRot with 2511 four-step Lightning; the specialized 2509 Relight LoRA and all original prompt/lighting controls are preserved. Verified on Cloud9 gfx1103 using exact same source/seed/1024-square golden-hour portrait: 618.58s versus 814.8s for 2509 (24.08% faster), visual PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS: subject and light coherent, background can recompose. Proof: validation/qwen2511-relight-2509lora-native-substitution-20261120.json. Other presets and strict background preservation are not certified. Whats Next still uses 2509; do not remove 2509 model.
